channel.title: PassionWavesMedia
channel.description: One place for the things I can't stop thinking about — the cloud, the road, the kitchen, and everything I'm still figuring out. If a piece here teaches you something or nudges you to start, it did its job.

item.title: I Tried to Replace Claude Code With a Local LLM. Here's Everything I Learned.
item.description: A journey through RAM upgrades, hallucinated tool calls, context windows, and the honest limits of consumer hardware, and where I landed instead.

item.title: How to Be a Great Customer Success Manager
item.description: What two-plus years as a CSM at a full-service IT consulting company taught me about trust, adaptability, and building the systems nobody hands you.

item.title: Greece & Europe Tour: Budapest to London
item.description: Eleven days, five countries: a group tour through Budapest, Bratislava, Vienna, Athens, Hydra, Santorini, and London.

item.title: Road Trip: Idaho, Oregon & Utah
item.description: A seven-day drive through Idaho, Oregon, and Utah: waterfalls, a mountain tramway, kayaking, hikes, and everything eaten along the way.

item.title: The Story Of…
item.description: A speech about a friend who lost both parents to cancer before he'd even finished school, and what he taught me about staying calm inside chaos.

item.title: A Work Week in New York
item.description: A work trip to New York that still found room for hot yoga, ice skating at Rockefeller Center, and a lot of very good food.

item.title: Vegan Guide to Eastvale
item.description: Eight Eastvale spots with real vegan orders worth making the trip for, from ramen to a beyond-sausage sandwich.

item.title: My Icebreaker Speech
item.description: The first speech every Toastmaster gives, an introduction, a name that's been mispronounced in every possible way, and where I am right now.

item.title: A Letter to My Friend, Rain
item.description: A speech written as a letter to an old friend, one who falls constantly and never gets hurt.

item.title: Rocky (Rap Song)
item.description: What my dog Rocky has taught me about awareness, presence, and taking a break, delivered as a rap, because a blog post dared me to.

item.title: Self-Driving Cars
item.description: A prepared speech on why autonomous vehicles still make the same kinds of mistakes they were built to eliminate.

item.title: On Time
item.description: A prepared speech on the one resource everyone has an opinion about and almost no one actually understands.

item.title: Valentine
item.description: What a relationship that didn't last still managed to teach me about self-care, solitude, and not losing track of everything else.
